fairnessControls: Pin every participant, runtime, model, prompt, tool set, and dependency version before the first measured run.
Use the same immutable workload fixtures and success predicates for every participant.
Run on the same isolated host class, randomize participant order, and separate cold-start from warm-run results.
Use at least 30 measured trials per scenario after five unmeasured warmups.
Capture raw event history, stdout, stderr, wall time, token use, provider cost, and operator interventions for every trial.
Publish failures and exclusions; an environment failure is inconclusive, never a product failure or pass.
Do not form a composite score until metric weights are preregistered for a named customer profile.

scenarios.workload: Complete step A, kill the workflow process before step B starts, restart, and finish the run.
successPredicates: step A external effect count equals 1
step B external effect count equals 1
run terminates with a declared completion reason

scenarios.workload: Kill execution after an effect is durably elected but before the provider acknowledgement is recorded.
successPredicates: attempt history explains the interrupted attempt

scenarios.workload: Return a syntactically valid but quality-gate-failing agent result, then permit bounded repair attempts.
successPredicates: terminal state is either verified success or a declared verification failure

scenarios.workload: Reach a human approval, stop all processes for ten minutes, restart, deliver the approval, and finish.
successPredicates: no compute is required while waiting
prior completed work is not repeated

scenarios.workload: Issue 20 concurrent resume requests for one interrupted run.
successPredicates: one replacement attempt receives the lease
all other requests are no-ops or typed conflicts

scenarios.workload: Crash after a model or memory result is committed and resume through completion.
successPredicates: resumed token total equals one execution per committed step
resumed provider cost equals one execution per committed step
journal attributes every charge to one step
